name: Sword of Life Stealing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: On a 20, an extra 3d6 Necrotic to a living target, and you gain that much in Temporary Hit Points.
text: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 3d6 Necrotic damage, provided that the target isn't a Construct or an Undead. You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the extra damage dealt.
